proposed_comments.title: Prevent telemetry hotkey pointers from being invalidated
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The reserve call belongs before the unchanged vector declaration; the current diff only adds a later telemetry argument.
proposed_comments.body:
### Prevent telemetry hotkey pointers from being invalidated

**Severity:** `high`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPasteModuleInterface/trace.cpp`, `AdvancedPaste_SettingsTelemetry` and its `hotkeyStrs` storage.

**Problem:** The helper returns pointers into a `std::vector<std::wstring>` while later calls keep appending. Reallocation can invalidate pointers already captured for TraceLogging arguments.

**Why it matters:** Telemetry can read invalid storage or report corrupted hotkey values.

**Suggested change:**
1. Keep the vector in the current helper scope.
2. Reserve `5 + additionalActionsHotkeys.size()` before any helper returns `c_str()` pointers.
3. Preserve the existing event field order.

**Verification:** Emit telemetry with all built-in and additional shortcuts populated and confirm every field is stable; build AdvancedPasteModuleInterface.

confidence.rationale: The helper appends before returning c_str pointers and the new field increases reallocation pressure.

proposed_comments.title: Append the new interop constant without shifting ABI ordinals
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The safe fix moves the declaration and definition across three interop files, so no single RIGHT-side suggestion can represent it.
proposed_comments.body:
### Append the new interop constant without shifting ABI ordinals

**Severity:** `high`

**Affected code:** `src/common/interop/Constants.idl`, `Constants.h`, and `Constants.cpp`, for `AdvancedPasteSingleLineMessage`.

**Problem:** Inserting the new static method near the beginning shifts every later generated interface ordinal.

**Why it matters:** Existing WinRT projections and cross-process callers can bind old numeric slots to the wrong constants.

**Suggested change:**
1. Remove the method from its early position in all three files.
2. Append it after the final existing constant consistently.
3. Regenerate projections and rebuild affected consumers.

**Verification:** Compare generated interface ordering before and after; confirm every existing ordinal is stable and build AdvancedPasteModuleInterface plus Settings consumers.

confidence.rationale: The current IDL insertion shifts generated ordering; the fork moves it consistently to the end.

proposed_comments.title: Restore end-to-end coverage for the single-line action
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The current head lacks the new source fixture and all three single-line UI scenarios, requiring coordinated multi-file additions.
proposed_comments.body:
### Restore end-to-end coverage for the single-line action

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/AdvancedPaste/UITest-AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPasteUITest.cs`, its `TestFiles` fixtures, and `UITestAdvancedPaste.md`.

**Problem:** The visible button, Ctrl+2 popup shortcut, and configured direct shortcut are not exercised end to end, and the multiline source fixture is absent.

**Why it matters:** UI automation wiring, shortcut routing, and clipboard flattening can regress without a test failure.

**Suggested change:**
1. Add a multiline source fixture with an embedded tab and an expected one-line result without a trailing newline.
2. Add separate tests for button, popup shortcut, and direct shortcut paths.
3. Give each assertion a path-specific failure message.
4. Document all three scenarios.

**Verification:** Build the Advanced Paste UI-test project and run the three focused Windows UI tests, confirming the tab is preserved and line breaks are removed.

confidence.rationale: The current head wires all three paths but lacks their fixtures and end-to-end scenarios.
